title: Evaluation-mate internal Hom comparison for the normalized pullback tensorator
statement: For any morphism f:X→Y of schemes with chosen sheaf derived categories, there exists a natural transformation Rf_* RHom_X(L,M)→RHom_Y(Rf_*L,Rf_*M) whose transpose on each test morphism A→Rf_*RHom_X(L,M) is pullback tensor comparison, identity tensor counit at L, then evaluation. All tensor-Hom equivalences and adjunctions are the fixed canonical ones [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-bijection, lem-sc-mixed-hom-tensor-pullback-iso, lem-pc-global-hom-adjunction].

proof.text: Apply the already proved generic internalHomMate_exists in GlobalHomAdjunctionIso to the fixed internal Hom functors, pullback/direct-image adjunction, normalized mixed tensorator and canonical tensor-Hom equivalences. The mate equation uniquely determines every component: set the test object equal to Rf_*RHom(L,M) and take its identity, then use the two inverse tensor-Hom and adjunction bijections. Naturality gives the natural transformation.
